title: Internal QA audit: Data integrity issue in NX-14 preclinical dataset (retracted)
body: This report has been retracted. An internal audit identified data integrity issues in the preclinical efficacy dataset for NX-14. Laboratory notebooks were not properly maintained, and raw data could not be reconciled with reported results. The preclinical work was flagged for re-evaluation. This document should not be used to support any regulatory submission or scientific claim.
